zh.name: 雅典卫城
zh.desc: 在爱琴海畔兴建城邦：轮流从工地取走板块、逐层叠建，让同类街区连成规模，并借广场与采石场赢取荣耀。
zh.rules:
目标：
每位玩家扮演一位建筑师，在各自的城市中建造住房、市场、兵营、神庙与花园。游戏结束时，按街区类型分别计算得分，总分最高者获胜；总分相同时，剩余石料较多者获胜。

准备：
将与本局人数相符的城市板块背面朝上洗混，平均分成 11 叠。四人游戏每叠 5 块，三人游戏每叠 4 块，两人游戏每叠 3 块。
将分叠后剩余的板块正面朝上在桌面中央排成一行，称为“工地”。每轮开始时，工地上有比建筑师人数多 2 块板块。
每位建筑师拿取 1 块起始板块放在自己面前。起始板块由 4 个建造格组成：中央是 1 个带 1 颗星的住房广场，周围是 3 个采石场。
最近一次爬过山的建筑师拿取首席建筑师标记，作为第一顺位。从第一顺位开始按顺时针方向，每位建筑师依次拿取石料：第一顺位 1 块，第二顺位 2 块，第三顺位 3 块，第四顺位 4 块。其余石料放在一旁作为公共储备。

流程：
游戏从首席建筑师开始，按顺时针方向轮流进行。每位建筑师在自己的回合依次执行两个步骤：先从工地取走一块板块，再把它放进自己的城市。建筑师持续轮流行动，直到工地只剩 1 块板块。

取板块：
建筑师可以选择工地上的任意一块板块。取第一块板块不需要支付石料；若要取更靠后的板块，每越过一块板块就要支付 1 块石料，支付的石料放回公共储备。
建筑师必须拥有足够的石料才能取走对应位置的板块；石料不足时，只能取第一块板块。建筑师取走板块后，必须在本回合内把它放入自己的城市。

放置板块：
每块城市板块由 3 个六边形建造格组成，分为采石场、广场和街区三类。板块可以自由旋转。
放在第 1 层的板块，必须至少有一条边与自己的另一块城市板块相邻，并且 3 个格子都必须是空地。
放在更高层的板块，必须完整压在 3 个已有格子上，不能悬空；这 3 个格子必须来自至少 2 块不同的板块，而且高度相同。新板块放在这些格子的上一层的同一高度。
被上层板块覆盖的格子不再保留原有的建造格：街区不再计分，广场不再提供星数，采石场也不再被重复计入。该位置仍然算作被你的城市占据，会影响兵营的边缘、神庙的包围与花园的湖泊判定。覆盖采石场时，每覆盖 1 个采石场，建筑师立即从公共储备获得 1 块石料。

建造格：
采石场本身不计分。当它被其它板块覆盖时，为覆盖它的建筑师提供 1 块石料。
广场带有 1 至 3 颗星，同一颜色的广场星数可以累加。广场只按颜色对应街区，不要求与同色街区相邻，也不因所在层数提高而增加星数。
街区共有五种类型，放置时没有限制，但只有满足该类型的放置条件、并且城市中至少有一个同色广场时，才能得分。街区位于第 1 层时价值为 1，第 2 层为 2，第 3 层为 3，以此类推。

街区放置条件：
· 住房为蓝色。只有城市中最大的一片相邻住房群计分；其它较小的住房群不计分。住房群可以跨越不同层，群的价值为群内每块住房所在层数之和。
· 市场为黄色。市场不能与任何其它市场相邻；相邻的市场都不计分。
· 兵营为红色。兵营必须位于城市边缘，也就是至少有一个相邻格为空。
· 神庙为紫色。神庙必须被完全包围，六个相邻格都必须有格子。
· 花园为绿色。花园没有放置条件，所有花园都可以计分。
相邻关系只看格子在城市平面上的位置，与格子所在的层数无关。例如第 2 层的住房可以与相邻的第 1 层住房属于同一片住房群。

补充工地：
一名建筑师完成回合后，如果工地只剩 1 块板块，就把该板块留在工地第一位，然后取下一叠板块正面朝上依次排在它后面，使工地重新达到“建筑师人数加 2”块。首席建筑师标记传给左侧的玩家，由新的首席建筑师继续行动。
若没有剩余的板块叠可以补充工地，则游戏结束。

结算：
每位建筑师按街区颜色分别计算得分：
· 先累加所有满足放置条件的同色街区的价值；街区每高一层，价值增加 1。
· 再累加城市中所有同色广场的星数。
· 将两者相乘，得到该颜色街区的得分。
五种颜色分别计算后相加。每块剩余石料额外提供 1 分。
总分最高的建筑师获胜；总分相同时，剩余石料较多者获胜。

变体：
开始游戏前可以加入以下任意组合的变体。每个变体为一种街区增加额外条件：满足额外条件时，该类街区的得分翻倍；不满足时仍按正常方式计分。额外条件不会取代原有的放置条件，街区仍须满足原条件，并且城市中仍须有同色广场。
· 住房：最大住房群的价值达到 10 或以上时，该住房群得分翻倍。
· 市场：市场与同色市场广场相邻时，该市场得分翻倍。
· 兵营：兵营有 3 个或 4 个相邻空格时，该兵营得分翻倍。
· 神庙：神庙建在第 2 层或更高层时，该神庙得分翻倍。
· 花园：花园与湖泊相邻时，该花园得分翻倍。湖泊是指六个相邻格都已被占据的空格。

en.name: Akropolis
en.desc: Raise a Greek city on the Aegean: draft tiles from the construction site, stack them upward, and grow matching districts, plazas and quarries into lasting glory.
en.rules:
Goal:
Each player is an architect building a city with houses, markets, barracks, temples and gardens. At the end of the game, score each district type separately. The player with the most points wins; if players tie on points, the player with the most stones wins.

Setup:
Shuffle the city tiles that match the player count face down and divide them into 11 equal stacks. Use 5 tiles per stack with 4 players, 4 with 3 players, and 3 with 2 players.
Place the tiles left over after stacking face up in a line in the center of the table. This line is the construction site. At the start of every round it holds 2 more tiles than there are architects.
Each architect takes 1 starting tile and places it in front of them. The starting tile has 4 construction spaces: a central housing plaza worth 1 star, surrounded by 3 quarries.
The architect who most recently climbed a hill takes the Chief Architect marker and becomes first player. Starting with the first player and proceeding clockwise, each architect takes stones: 1 for the first player, 2 for the second, 3 for the third, and 4 for the fourth. The remaining stones form the common reserve.

Play:
Starting with the Chief Architect and proceeding clockwise, architects take turns. On your turn, first take one tile from the construction site, then add it to your city. Play continues until only 1 tile remains in the construction site.

Taking a tile:
You may choose any tile in the construction site. Taking the first tile is free; for a tile further back, pay 1 stone for each tile you pass over, returning those stones to the common reserve.
You must have enough stones to take a tile at that position. If you do not have enough stones, you must take the first tile. Once you take a tile, you must add it to your city during the same turn.

Adding a tile:
Each city tile consists of 3 hexagonal construction spaces: quarries, plazas and districts. A tile may be rotated freely.
A tile placed on the 1st level must share at least one edge with another of your city tiles, and all 3 of its spaces must be empty.
A tile placed on a higher level must cover 3 existing spaces completely and may not overhang. Those 3 spaces must belong to at least 2 different tiles and must all be at the same height. The new tile is placed on the next level above them.
A space covered by a tile above no longer keeps its construction space: its district does not score, its plaza provides no stars, and its quarry is no longer counted. The position is still occupied by your city, so it still matters for a barracks edge, a temple's surround and a garden's lake. When you cover a quarry, take 1 stone from the common reserve for each quarry covered.

Construction spaces:
Quarries do not score. When a quarry is covered by another tile, the architect who covers it takes 1 stone.
Plazas show 1 to 3 stars. Stars on plazas of the same colour add together. A plaza matches districts by colour only; it does not need to border a district of that colour, and its stars do not increase with the level it occupies.
There are five district types. You may place a district freely, but it scores only when it meets the placement condition for its type and your city contains at least one plaza of the same colour. A district on the 1st level is worth 1, on the 2nd level 2, on the 3rd level 3, and so on.

District placement conditions:
· Houses are blue. Only the largest single group of adjacent houses in your city scores; smaller groups do not. A house group may span levels, and its value is the sum of the levels of its houses.
· Markets are yellow. A market must not be adjacent to any other market; markets that touch another market do not score.
· Barracks are red. A barracks must be on the edge of your city, meaning at least one adjacent space is empty.
· Temples are purple. A temple must be completely surrounded, with all six adjacent spaces occupied.
· Gardens are green. Gardens have no placement condition, so every garden scores.
Adjacency depends only on positions in the city plan, not on level. For example, a house on the 2nd level can belong to the same group as an adjacent house on the 1st level.

Supplying the construction site:
After an architect finishes their turn, if only 1 tile remains in the construction site, leave it in the first position, then take the next stack of tiles and place its tiles face up after it so that the site again holds 2 more tiles than there are architects. Pass the Chief Architect marker to the player on the left, and continue play with the new Chief Architect.
If no stacks remain to replenish the site, the game ends.

Scoring:
Each architect scores each district colour separately:
· Add up the values of all districts of that colour that meet their placement condition. A district is worth 1 more point for each level above the first.
· Add up the stars on all plazas of that colour in your city.
· Multiply the two numbers to obtain the points for that colour.
Add the five colour totals together. Each stone you have left is worth 1 additional point.
The architect with the most points wins. If players tie on points, the player with the most stones wins.

Variants:
Before the game, you may add any combination of the following variants. Each variant adds an extra condition for one district type: when the extra condition is met, that district's points are doubled; otherwise it scores normally. The extra condition does not replace the usual placement condition. The district must still meet its usual condition, and your city must still contain a plaza of that colour.
· Houses: if your largest group of houses has a value of 10 or more, that group's points are doubled.
· Markets: if a market is next to a market plaza, that market's points are doubled.
· Barracks: if a barracks has 3 or 4 empty adjacent spaces, that barracks' points are doubled.
· Temples: if a temple is built on the 2nd level or higher, that temple's points are doubled.
· Gardens: if a garden is adjacent to a lake, that garden's points are doubled. A lake is an empty space whose six adjacent spaces are all occupied.

zh.name: 诡镇奇谈：卡牌版
zh.desc: 构筑牌组，调查阿卡姆的诡秘事件
zh.rules:
目标：调查异象，完成当前剧本的目标。
准备：
· 选择战役、难度和调查员，构筑符合调查员要求的牌组。
· 每位调查员开始时获得5个资源，抽取5张手牌并进行一次调度。
流程：
· 神话阶段增加毁灭标记，检查密谋并依次抽取遭遇卡；首轮跳过。
· 调查阶段由玩家选择行动顺序，每位调查员通常执行3个行动。
· 移动、调查、战斗、躲避、交战、抽牌和获得资源通常消耗1个行动。
· 技能检定先投入卡牌，再抽取混乱标记，比较修正后的技能值与难度。
· 敌军阶段处理猎手移动及敌人攻击，补给阶段重置卡牌、抽牌并获得资源。
结算：
· 按剧本结局记录经验、创伤和剧情变化，升级牌组后继续战役。

en.name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game
en.desc: Build your deck and investigate the mysteries of Arkham
en.rules:
Goal: investigate the mysteries and achieve the scenario objective.
Setup:
· Choose a campaign, difficulty and investigator; build a legal deck.
· Each investigator starts with 5 resources and 5 cards, then may mulligan once.
Play:
· The mythos phase adds doom, checks the agenda and draws encounters; skip it in round one.
· Choose investigator turn order; each investigator normally takes 3 actions.
· Moving, investigating, fighting, evading, engaging, drawing and gaining resources normally cost 1 action.
· Commit cards before revealing a chaos token; compare the modified skill value with the difficulty.
· In the enemy phase, hunters move and enemies attack; upkeep readies cards, draws a card and gains a resource.
Resolution:
· Record experience, trauma and story consequences, upgrade your deck and continue the campaign.

zh.name: 温馨贴纸小镇
zh.desc: 在双面村庄地图上贴满居民与建筑，经营十年温馨小镇。
zh.rules:
目标：
用十年时间建设温馨贴纸小镇，让居民幸福生活，并在结束时获得尽可能高的小镇评分。本作为单人游戏，没有失败条件；根据最终心情与达成的内容，你会读到五个结局之一。

地图与贴纸：
地图分为正反两面，开局时选择其中一面。两面地图都由草地、水域与岩地组成，一条河流把草地分成两岸，折痕把地图分成若干版块；完成一局后，可以在另一面地图上再玩一次。贴纸分为地形贴纸与透明贴纸：地形贴纸带有草地、水域或岩地背景，必须贴在背景相符的地形上；透明贴纸没有背景，可以叠放在任意贴纸上。放置地形贴纸时，贴纸的格子必须与地图网格对齐，全部格子都要落在相符的地形内，并且所有草地贴纸都必须位于河流的同一侧；建成桥梁后，本局余下时间不受此限制。任何地形贴纸都不能跨越折痕。地形贴纸不能覆盖其他地形贴纸，只有效果明确允许覆盖时，才能盖在其他贴纸上。

开局：
从第九页的起始贴纸中，每一对只能选择一枚，一共把八枚贴纸放到地图上。八枚起始贴纸放置完成后，按地图上的图标获得一次岁初收入，随后第一年开始。起始心情为两颗心。

每年流程：
每年使用一组十二张事件牌作为牌库，并按随机顺序排列。每天清晨，你从牌库抽取一张事件牌，然后按下列步骤进行：
· 若事件牌印有选项，你从可支付的选项中选取一项，支付其费用并立即结算效果。
· 若事件牌没有选项且符合留场条件，将它留在场上，再进入午后。若不符合，弃掉该牌并按牌上说明处理。
结算完成后进入午后，你可以执行一次午后行动：
· 使用一张留场建筑牌上印有的行动。
· 使用一张图鉴牌上印有的行动。
· 使用一枚已放置贴纸印有的“阅读故事”行动。
你也可以不执行行动，直接结束这一天。执行一次行动后，本日随即结束；若效果给予额外行动，你可以在同一天继续行动。若牌库还有牌，就进入下一天；若牌库已空，则进入岁末。

岁初收入：
放置完起始贴纸后，以及从第二年起每年开始时，按地图上未被遮住的图标获得资源：每个木材图标获得一份木材，每个食物图标获得一份食物，里程碑上的每枚未覆盖的金币王冠图标提供一枚金币。矿石不能通过这种方式获得。被地形贴纸遮住的贴纸不再提供图标与行动。

资源、心情与不满：
木材、食物、金币与矿石的数量受供应限制：木材、食物与金币最多各十二个，矿石最多六个。心情沿地图上的心情轨道记录，最多三十颗心。部分效果会增加或移除不满标记；不满本身没有固定规则，只在明确引用它的效果中起作用。

岁初设置：
第一年开始前，按故事书的岁初设置执行。从第二年开始，每年开始先结算当年的岁初设置，再抽取当年第一张事件牌：
· 第二年：获得图鉴牌 42。
· 第三年：若你拥有“Hunger”里程碑，失去 1 颗心；否则获得 1 金币。
· 第四年：若你已放置起始贴纸 9L，则把 7N 覆盖在指定位置，并失去 2 份食物；否则获得 1 份食物。
· 第五年：放置贴纸 5C；若无法放置，则改为放置贴纸 5D。
· 第六年：若你拥有“Lodge”里程碑，放置贴纸 4T；否则获得图鉴牌 22。
· 第七年：若你拥有“Degenerate”或“Upstanding”里程碑，获得 1 份矿石；否则阅读故事 18.3。
· 第八年：若你拥有“Lucky”里程碑，可以免费放置花朵贴纸 11A，或花费 1 金币放置道路贴纸 3E；否则把贴纸 10E 放在悬崖边。
· 第九年：若你已放置贴纸 8H，获得 2 金币；否则放置贴纸 7E，并把事件牌 Y6-12 移出本局。
· 第十年：没有额外的岁初设置。

岁末与终局：
每年结束时，先依次结算留场建筑与图鉴牌上标注的岁末效果，再进入下一年。第十年结束后计算小镇评分：评分为心情、里程碑数量与图鉴牌数量之和，并根据心情落在哪一档给出对应结局。

保存：
使用“保存小镇”把进度写入本机档案；只有界面显示已保存，才代表写入成功。开局选项可以载入已有档案；若档案被其他页面更新，请重新载入最新档案。

改编说明：
本电子版把原版的纸质贴纸与故事书改编为可交互的地图、卡牌与故事弹层。以下细节采用固定分支或近似处理：
· 卡面贴纸数量按图鉴牌上实际放置的爱心与进度贴纸结算。
· 竞选州长（故事 9.3、27.1）固定为花费 3 金币并掷骰，掷出 4 至 6 即成功。
· 烘焙比赛（故事 26.6）按选定的食物数量结算掷骰与奖励，但不限制卡 28 能否带来额外行动。
· 岁初设置中的指定位置以任意合法位置近似：第四年的 7N 与第八年的 10E 可以放在任何合法位置，第八年的悬崖相邻关系不单独判定。
· 居民数量按地图贴纸插画中的人物精确统计。
· 卡 36 按玩家输入的当前时间与分针位置结算；卡 22、31、45、50 的谜题仍以阅读对应的提示故事条目结算。
起始贴纸按贴纸编号顺序两两成对，具体结果以牌面与故事条目的文字为准。

en.name: Cozy Stickerville
en.desc: Fill a double-sided village map with residents and buildings across ten cozy years.
en.rules:
Goal:
Build the cozy town of Stickerville over ten years, keep its residents happy, and finish with the highest town score you can. This is a solo game with no way to lose; your final hearts and achievements lead you to one of five endings.

Map and stickers:
The map has two sides, and you choose one at setup. Both sides are made of grass, water, and rock; a river splits the grass into two banks, and folds divide the map into panels. After finishing a game you may play again on the other side. Stickers come in terrain stickers and clear stickers: a terrain sticker carries a grass, water, or rock background and must be placed on matching terrain, while a clear sticker has no background and may be stacked on any sticker. When you place a terrain sticker, its cells must line up with the map grid, every cell must fall on matching terrain, and all grass stickers must stay on one bank of the river; after a bridge is built this restriction no longer applies. No terrain sticker may straddle a fold. A terrain sticker may not cover another terrain sticker, and it may cover another sticker only when an effect explicitly allows it.

Setup:
From the page-nine starting stickers, you choose exactly one of each pair and place eight stickers on the map. Once all eight are placed, you gain one year-setup income from the icons on the map, and year 1 begins. You start with two hearts.

Yearly flow:
Each year uses twelve event cards, shuffled into its deck. Every morning you draw one event card, then follow these steps:
· If the card prints options, choose one you can afford, pay its cost, and resolve its effect immediately.
· If the card has no options and meets the conditions for staying in play, keep it and enter the afternoon. Otherwise, discard it and follow its instructions.
After resolution the afternoon begins, and you may take one afternoon action:
· use an action printed on a kept building card;
· use an action printed on a catalog card;
· use a “read story” action printed on a placed sticker.
You may also end the day without taking an action. Your day ends after one action; if an effect grants an extra action, you may keep acting that day. If the deck still has cards, the next day begins; otherwise the year ends.

Year-setup income:
After the starting stickers are placed, and at the start of every year from year 2 onward, you gain resources from the uncovered icons on the map: one wood for each wood icon, one food for each food icon, and one gold for each uncovered gold crown icon on your milestones. Ore is never gained this way. Stickers hidden under a terrain sticker no longer provide icons or actions.

Resources, hearts, and upset:
Wood, food, gold, and ore are limited by the supply: wood, food, and gold cap at twelve each, and ore caps at six. Hearts are tracked on the map’s happiness track, up to thirty. Some effects add or remove upset stickers; upset has no fixed rule of its own and matters only in effects that explicitly refer to it.

Year setup:
Before year 1 begins, follow the storybook’s year setup. From year 2 onward, resolve the year’s setup before drawing that year’s first event card:
· Year 2: gain catalog card 42.
· Year 3: if you have the Hunger milestone, lose 1 heart; otherwise gain 1 gold.
· Year 4: if the starting sticker 9L is on the map, cover the indicated spot with 7N and lose 2 food; otherwise gain 1 food.
· Year 5: place sticker 5C; if it cannot be placed, place sticker 5D instead.
· Year 6: if you have a Lodge milestone, place sticker 4T; otherwise gain catalog card 22.
· Year 7: if you have the Degenerate or Upstanding milestone, gain 1 ore; otherwise read story 18.3.
· Year 8: if you have the Lucky milestone, either place the flower sticker 11A for free or spend 1 gold to place the road sticker 3E; otherwise place sticker 10E by the cliff.
· Year 9: if sticker 8H is on the map, gain 2 gold; otherwise place sticker 7E and remove event card Y6-12 from this game.
· Year 10: there is no further setup.

Year end and finale:
At each year end, resolve the year-end effects printed on kept buildings and catalog cards in turn, then begin the next year. After year 10 you tally the town score: hearts plus the number of milestones plus the number of catalog cards, and your hearts decide which of the five endings you read.

Saving:
Use “Save town” to write your progress to this device’s archive; it is only saved once the interface says so. The setup options can load an existing archive; if another page updates the archive, load the newest one again.

Adaptation note:
This digital edition turns the physical stickers and storybook into an interactive map, cards, and story sheets. The following details use fixed branches or approximations:
· Card sticker counts use the heart and progress stickers actually placed on the catalog card.
· Running for governor (stories 9.3 and 27.1) is always a 3-gold roll that succeeds on 4 to 6.
· The baking competition (story 26.6) resolves the roll and reward for the chosen amount of food but does not prevent card 28 from granting an extra action.
· The indicated spots in year setup are approximated by any legal placement: 7N in year 4 and 10E in year 8 may go anywhere legal, and year 8 does not check cliff-side adjacency.
· Resident counts are read from the people shown in the artwork of uncovered stickers.
· Card 36 uses the current time entered by the player and the exact minute-hand position; cards 22, 31, 45, and 50 still resolve their puzzles by reading the corresponding hint story entries.
Starting stickers pair up in sticker-number order, and the printed text on cards and story entries remains the reference for each result.

zh.name: 动物星餐厅
zh.desc: 派遣厨师采购食材，完成挑战餐并征服评论家，比谁获得最多星星
zh.rules:
目标:
在七轮采购与烹饪中，用厨师从各处集市挑选食材与香料，完成挑战餐并打动美食评论家。游戏结束时星星最多的玩家获胜。
准备:

· 把所有食材、香料与谣言标记放入袋中并洗混。食材共有面包、胡萝卜、奶酪、鱼、肉、蘑菇与酒七种类型，数值从 2 到 7。每种香料有两枚，另有万能香料。

· 随机抽取一名评论家卡放在桌上，它在第三天为所有玩家试吃。
· 每名玩家获得两张餐厅老板卡，暗选一张保留，另一张放回盒中。
· 抽取三张谣言卡正面朝上摆放，并从袋中放入对应的谣言标记与狂野标记。
· 按人数摆放地点板。两人局使用汤车、花园顶店、沙漠商贩、午夜商人与厨师学院。
· 由系统随机决定优先轨顺序，之后玩家的相对顺序会随采购改变。

一局共进行七轮，分为三天。第一至三轮为第一天，第四至六轮为第二天，第七轮为第三天。每轮依次经历安排厨师与采购两个阶段。第一天与第二天结束时结算挑战餐并冷藏，第三天结束时为评论家上菜。

· 玩家也可以把当轮拥有的助理厨师安排到地点。助理厨师同样不能与其他厨师或另一名助理厨师占用同一地点。

冷藏:

评论家试餐:

餐厅老板:

en.name: Critter Kitchen
en.desc: Send chefs to gather ingredients, serve challenge meals, and win over the critic for the most stars
en.rules:
Goal:
Across seven rounds of shopping and cooking, send your chefs to markets around town to gather ingredients and spice, serve challenge meals, and impress the food critic. The player with the most stars at the end of the game wins.
Setup:
· Each player takes their three chefs and a kitchen board.
· Put all ingredient, spice, and rumor tokens into the bag and shuffle it. There are seven ingredient types: bread, carrot, cheese, fish, meat, mushroom, and wine, with values from 2 to 7. Each spice type has two tokens, and there is also allspice.
· Shuffle the seven Challenge Cards, deal six face down in a row, and set the seventh aside. Reveal one at the start of each round.
· Draw one Critic Card at random and place it face up; it tastes every restaurant on the third day.
· Each player is dealt two Restaurateur Cards, keeps one face down, and returns the other to the box.
· Reveal three Rumor Cards and add their matching Rumor Tokens plus the wild tokens to the bag.
· Set out the Location Boards for the player count. With two players, use the Soup Truck, Garden Top Shop, Desert Vendor, Midnight Merchant, and Chef Academy.
· The priority track starts in a random order; shopping changes the relative order as the game goes on.
Rounds and days:
The game lasts seven rounds divided into three days. Rounds one to three are day one, rounds four to six are day two, and round seven is day three. Each round has a planning step and a shopping step. Days one and two end with challenge meals and refrigeration; day three ends with the critic meal.
Restaurateur:
This happens once before round one. Each player chooses one of their two Restaurateur Cards. Its ability applies for the rest of the game, and the stars printed at the top count toward the final score.
Planning:
· All players simultaneously assign their three chefs to three different locations.
· A player may also assign any zous-chefs they have for the round. A zous-chef cannot share a location with another chef or with another zous-chef.
· In six- and seven-player games, a break number from 1 to 3 is rolled at the start of each round. Each player puts one chef on break; that chef does not visit a location. If the chef on break matches the rolled number, the player gains two soup. If a player does not choose, the chef matching the roll is put on break.
· Once every player confirms planning, shopping begins.
Shopping:
· Shopping resolves locations in board order. Each location has queues for carrying capacity 1, 2, and 3. Chefs of the same capacity take turns from the front of the priority track onward.
· On a chef’s turn, they take one item from the location. Each chef takes up to their carrying capacity, then play passes to the next chef or the next capacity group.
· If a chef is the first to pick at the location and is tied on the priority track, only that chef moves their hat to the back.
· A player who has not picked anything may leave and gain one soup. After picking at least once, they must keep picking until they reach capacity or the location is empty.
· After a location resolves, leftover ingredients and spice move to the Chef Academy, and leftover rumor tokens and cart items are discarded.
· Once every player finishes shopping, the round ends. Days one and two then resolve challenge meals and refrigeration.
Challenge meals:
· A new Challenge Card is revealed at the start of each round. At the end of days one and two, the three challenges revealed over that day are available.
· Each Challenge Card lists three required ingredient types. A challenge meal must contain at least one of each required type. A missing type may be replaced by one soup, and one soup replaces only one missing type. A meal cannot consist only of soup.
· A challenge meal may also include any number of matching ingredients and soup.
· The last challenge revealed on days one and two carries a Hold Token that covers its rightmost requirement; the covered requirement is not needed.
· Add up ingredient values for the meal’s quality. Spice doubles the value of the ingredient it is paired with, soup counts as 1, and bisque counts as 3.
· A meal with quality below 6 cannot be presented. Quality 6 to 11 earns 1 star, 12 to 20 earns 2 stars, and 21 or more earns 4 stars.
· Each player may serve up to three challenge meals per day, at most one per Challenge Card. After serving, soup and bisque return to the supply, and ingredients and spice return to the bag.
Refrigeration:
· At the end of day one, a player may refrigerate up to five countable items; at the end of day two, up to ten. Day three has no refrigeration.
· Ingredients, spice, tofu, and flowers can be refrigerated. Soup, bisque, rumor tokens, and public items do not count.
· Ingredients and spice that are not refrigerated return to the bag. Flowers and organic ingredients follow their own rules.
Critic meal:
· After shopping on day three, each player prepares seven courses for the critic. The courses are bread, carrot, cheese, fish, meat, mushroom, and wine in that order. Each course holds one ingredient and may also include one spice.
· Soup cannot replace an ingredient in the critic meal. Tofu must be paired with spice to be served.
· Each course’s ingredient values add up to that course’s quality; spice doubles the value of its ingredient.
· Serving all seven courses earns 1 star. The highest quality in each course earns 1 star, and ties all earn it.
· The most soup and bisque earns 1 star, counting soup as 1 and bisque as 3 each.
· Then score all revealed Rumor Cards, Restaurateur abilities, trophies, gold coins, coffee, and critic abilities.
· The seven courses’ total quality sets the position on the scoring track; take the stars shown for that position, with spaces one through seven each worth 1 star. Passing space seventy earns 10 stars and continues from the top.
· The player with the most stars wins. Ties compare total critic-meal quality, then priority-track position.
Restaurateurs:
· Each player keeps one Restaurateur Card at setup. Its ability applies for the whole game, and the stars printed at the top count toward the final score.
· The base game has ten Restaurateur Cards, and the expansion adds four. Each ability is printed on its card and can be viewed at any time.
Rumors:
· At setup, three Rumor Cards are revealed and placed face up. Each has three matching Rumor Tokens in the bag, along with the wild rumor tokens.
· When a player picks a rumor token while shopping, they place it in the matching rumor slot on their kitchen and immediately look at that Rumor Card. A wild token goes into any empty slot and looks at that slot’s rumor.
· A player may not collect the same rumor again. When every player knows a rumor, flip it face up.
· At final scoring, every revealed rumor applies to every player, whether or not that player knows it.
Carts:
· With the expansion enabled, one cart is placed at the Garden Top Shop, Desert Vendor, and Water Market, each offering a special item. Two-player games use only two carts.
· Cart items are picked like other items and restocked each round as printed on the cart. Leftover cart items are discarded at the end of the round, except for gift boxes.
· This edition includes nine carts: Coffee, Flowers, Trophies, Gift, Gold Coins, Mystery Box, Organic, Tofu, and Zous Too.
· The expansion’s Gelato, Sauces, Newspapers, Dumplings, and Food Drive carts have no available card text, so this edition does not include them.
Zous-chefs:
· A zous-chef is an extra helper. After picking one, a player assigns it during the next round’s planning step. It does not use one of the three chef assignments, but it cannot share a location with another chef or another zous-chef.
· A new zous-chef appears at the Chef Academy each round; the player who picks it uses it in the next round. A zous-chef works for only one round and then leaves, and cannot be saved for later.
· Six- and seven-player games and the Zous Too cart let a player have more than one zous-chef at a time.
· Each zous-chef triggers at the timing printed on its card: Start of Location, Before Your First Pick, or After Your Last Pick.
Optional content:
· This edition includes the base game and the À La Cart expansion: nine carts, twenty-four expansion zous-chefs, four expansion critics, four expansion restaurateurs, and the six- and seven-player mode.
· Solo mode has no available card data and is not included. The remaining expansion carts are also not included.

zh.name: Duel for Cardia
zh.desc: 双方轮流出牌交锋，以影响力争夺印戒；率先取得五枚印戒的人获胜。
zh.rules:
目标：
每位玩家使用相同的 16 张角色牌牌库进行对决。双方轮流打出一张牌形成交锋，影响力较高的牌赢得交锋并获得印戒。率先让自己打出的牌上累计 5 枚印戒的玩家赢得本局游戏。

准备：
· 双方选择相同的牌库（牌库 I 或牌库 II）。每名玩家洗混自己的 16 张角色牌，抽取 5 张作为手牌，其余牌作为自己的牌库。
· 如果选择了地点，把该地点牌正面朝上放在桌上。地点的规则对整个游戏持续生效，并且对双方同时适用。
· 把印戒、影响力增减标记和持续标记放在双方都能拿到的公共供应区。印戒和持续标记的数量按需要取用；持续标记不足时可以用合适的替代物。

每轮流程：
阶段 1：出牌与亮牌。双方各从手中选择 1 张牌，背面朝上放在自己一侧，形成一场新的交锋。双方都放好后，同时亮出这两张牌并比较影响力。影响力较高的牌赢得这次交锋，从供应区拿取 1 枚印戒放在获胜牌上。若双方影响力相同，这次交锋为平局，不放置印戒，并跳过阶段 2。
阶段 2：发动能力。只有输掉当前交锋的玩家发动其失败牌的能力。玩家必须尽可能完整地结算能力，包括能力对其他牌造成的后果。能力与一般规则冲突时，以能力文字为准。
阶段 3：轮末。双方各从自己的牌库顶抽取 1 张牌。牌库为空时不能抽牌，也不要洗混弃牌堆；不能抽牌不会导致失败。随后开始下一轮。

影响力与标记：
· 牌的基础影响力印在牌上。影响力增减标记会立即加入或扣除该牌的影响力，并在标记留在牌上期间持续生效。一张牌可以同时有正负标记，合计后可能为负数。
· 每当一张牌的影响力超过与它相对的牌，就把印戒放到影响力较高的牌上，并把对方牌上的印戒放回供应区。若两张牌影响力相同，则把该交锋中的印戒放回供应区。
· 能力使过去的交锋改变胜负时，只移动或移除印戒，不再次发动新落败牌的能力。
· 若能力要求把标记放在“你打出的下一张牌”上，就把标记放在当前交锋中你下一张牌的位置；你亮出下一张牌时立即把标记放到该牌上，并在阶段 1 比较影响力时计入。

能力类型：
· 即时能力：发动时立即结算一次，然后结束。
· 持续能力：发动时在牌上放置 1 枚持续标记。只要标记留在牌上，能力就持续生效；即使这张牌后来赢得交锋，能力仍然有效。持续标记被移除时，能力立即失效，并立即结算由此产生的所有变化。

交锋位置与弃牌：
· “上一场交锋”指当前交锋沿出牌方向相邻的上一场交锋。“过去的交锋”指当前交锋之前的所有交锋。“下一场交锋”指沿出牌方向紧随其后的交锋。
· 弃置的牌正面朝上放入弃牌堆，牌上的标记放回供应区。双方可以随时查看双方的弃牌堆。
· 若一场交锋中的两张牌都被弃置，后续交锋会向前移动以填补空位，位置关系按移动后的顺序重新确定。

结束条件：
· 阶段 1：若对手无法打出一张牌，你立即赢得本局游戏。
· 阶段 2：若你发动的能力说明你赢得本局游戏，你立即获胜。
· 阶段 3：轮末拥有 5 枚或更多印戒的玩家获胜。若双方都拥有至少 5 枚且数量相同，游戏继续，直到一方印戒更多或以其他方式获胜。
· 若阶段 1 中双方都无法出牌，印戒较多者获胜；若印戒数量相同，本局为平局。

牌库 I 的卡牌能力：
· 雇佣刀手（影响力 1，起义军，即时能力）：弃置这张牌与它相对的牌，然后关闭因此空出的交锋位置。
· 虚空法师（影响力 2，学院，即时能力）：选择任意一张已打出的牌，移除其上的全部影响力增减标记，或移除其上的全部持续标记。
· 外科医师（影响力 3，公会，即时能力）：你打出的下一张牌失去 5 点影响力。
· 调停者（影响力 4，王朝，持续能力）：本次交锋视为平局。
· 破坏者（影响力 5，起义军，即时能力）：对手从其牌库顶弃置 2 张牌。
· 预言师（影响力 6，学院，即时能力）：在下一场交锋中，对手先于你亮出其打出的牌。
· 宫廷守卫（影响力 7，公会，即时能力）：选择一个阵营。对手可以弃置其手中 1 张该阵营的牌；若对手不弃置，这张牌获得 7 点影响力。
· 法官（影响力 8，王朝，持续能力）：你赢得所有平局的交锋，包括今后的交锋。由平局改为获胜时，不触发对方牌的能力。
· 伏击者（影响力 9，起义军，即时能力）：选择一个阵营。对手弃置其手中所有该阵营的牌。
· 傀儡师（影响力 10，学院，即时能力）：弃置对手当前交锋中的牌，然后从对手手中随机抽取 1 张牌替换它。被抽出的牌不触发能力。
· 钟表匠（影响力 11，公会，即时能力）：上一场交锋中你打出的牌，以及你打出的下一张牌，各获得 3 点影响力。
· 司库（影响力 12，王朝，持续能力）：上一场交锋的获胜牌额外计 1 枚印戒。
· 沼泽守卫（影响力 13，起义军，即时能力）：将你另一张已打出的牌收回手中，并弃置与它相对的牌。
· 女导师（影响力 14，学院，即时能力）：复制并发动你另一张已打出的牌的即时能力；该牌的影响力必须不低于这张牌。
· 发明家（影响力 15，公会，即时能力）：任意一张牌获得 3 点影响力，另一张任意牌失去 3 点影响力。
· 灯神（影响力 16，王朝，即时能力）：你立即赢得本局游戏。

牌库 II 的卡牌能力：
· 投毒者（影响力 1，起义军，即时能力）：降低对手当前交锋中牌的影响力，直到本次交锋成为平局。
· 念力法师（影响力 2，学院，即时能力）：将你一张牌上的全部影响力增减标记与持续标记移到你另一张已打出的牌上。
· 使节（影响力 3，公会，即时能力）：任意一张牌失去 3 点影响力，或你打出的下一张牌失去 3 点影响力。
· 税吏（影响力 4，王朝，即时能力）：这张牌获得 4 点影响力。
· 革命者（影响力 5，起义军，即时能力）：对手弃置其手中 2 张牌，然后抽取 2 张牌。
· 图书管理员（影响力 6，学院，即时能力）：你打出的下一张牌亮出后，你选择使其获得 2 点影响力或失去 2 点影响力。
· 神童（影响力 7，公会，即时能力）：你一张影响力不高于 8 的已打出牌获得 3 点影响力。
· 贵族（影响力 8，王朝，持续能力）：若这张牌赢得其交锋，它额外计 1 枚印戒。
· 勒索者（影响力 9，起义军，即时能力）：选择一个阵营。若对手下一场打出的牌不属于该阵营，对手在亮牌后弃置其手中 2 张牌。
· 幻术师（影响力 10，学院，即时能力）：发动你一张正输掉其交锋的牌的能力。
· 工程师（影响力 11，公会，即时能力）：在能力结算之后，你打出的下一张牌获得 5 点影响力。
· 顾问（影响力 12，王朝，持续能力）：在上一场交锋中，你的牌获胜，对手的牌落败。
· 巫王（影响力 13，起义军，即时能力）：选择一个阵营。对手弃置其手中与牌库中所有该阵营的牌，然后洗混其牌库。
· 元素师（影响力 14，学院，即时能力）：弃置你手中 1 张具有即时能力的牌，复制并发动该能力，然后抽取 1 张牌。
· 机械灯神（影响力 15，公会，持续能力）：若你赢得下一场交锋，你立即赢得本局游戏。
· 继任者（影响力 16，王朝，即时能力）：对手弃置其整个牌库，并只保留手中 2 张牌。

地点：
· 蛇神殿（难度 1）：每当你赢得一场过去的交锋时，你抽取 1 张牌，对手弃置其手中 1 张牌。
· 集市（难度 1）：每轮结束时，你不抽牌。每当你手中只有 1 张或更少的牌时，立即抽取 4 张牌。
· 建城纪念日（难度 3）：若你曾连续赢得 3 场交锋，你立即赢得本局游戏。
· 大图书馆（难度 2）：游戏开始时，你抽取 2 张牌而非 5 张。每轮结束时，你抽取 2 张牌而非 1 张。
· 废料场（难度 2）：每轮结束时，若你的牌库中至少有 2 张牌，你抽取 2 张牌而非 1 张，然后将手中 1 张牌置于你的牌库底部。
· 拍卖行（难度 2）：每当你亮出的牌影响力低于你上一场交锋的牌时，你弃置牌库顶的 1 张牌。
· 闹鬼地下墓穴（难度 3）：若你亮出的牌与你上一场交锋的牌属于同一阵营，你立即输掉本局游戏。
· 迷雾沼泽（难度 2）：你打出牌后，不亮出当前交锋的牌；改为亮出并结算上一场交锋。

en.name: Duel for Cardia
en.desc: Two rivals play cards into successive encounters, competing for signets. The first to collect five signets wins.
en.rules:
Goal:
Each player duels with the same 16-character deck. You play one card at a time to form encounters, and the higher influence wins a signet. The first player to collect 5 signets on their played cards wins the game.

Setup:
· Both players choose the same deck (Deck I or Deck II). Each player shuffles their own 16 character cards, draws 5 cards as their hand, and places the rest face down as their deck.
· If you choose a location, place that location card face up on the table. Its rule applies for the whole game and to both players.
· Place the signets, influence modifiers, and ongoing tokens within reach as a shared supply. Take as many signets and ongoing tokens as needed; if tokens run out, use suitable substitutes.

Each round:
Phase 1: Play and reveal. Each player chooses 1 card from their hand and places it face down on their side, forming a new encounter. After both have placed, reveal both cards simultaneously and compare their influence. The higher-influence card wins the encounter; take 1 signet from the supply and place it on the winning card. If both influences are equal, the encounter is a tie, no signet is placed, and phase 2 is skipped.
Phase 2: Activate an ability. Only the player whose card loses the current encounter activates that card ability. Resolve the ability as fully as possible, including all consequences for other cards. If an ability contradicts the general rules, the ability takes precedence.
Phase 3: End of the round. Each player draws 1 card from the top of their deck. If a deck is empty, that player cannot draw; do not shuffle the discard pile, and being unable to draw does not cause a loss. Then begin the next round.

Influence and modifiers:
· A card printed influence is its base value. Influence modifiers are added to or subtracted from that value immediately and remain in effect while the modifiers stay on the card. Positive and negative modifiers on the same card are combined, and the total influence can be negative.
· Whenever a card influence exceeds that of the opposing card, place a signet on the higher-influence card and return any signets on the opposing card to the supply. If both influences are equal, return the encounter signets to the supply.
· If an ability changes the result of a past encounter, move or remove the signets, but do not activate the ability of the card that newly loses.
· If an ability places a modifier on “the next card you play,” place it in the space for your next card in the current encounter. When you reveal that card, place the modifier on it immediately; the modifier counts during the phase 1 influence comparison.

Ability types:
· Instant ability: activate it once and resolve it immediately.
· Ongoing ability: place 1 ongoing token on the card when you activate it. The ability remains in effect while the token stays on the card, even if that card later wins its encounter. If the token is removed, the ability ends immediately and any resulting changes are resolved immediately.

Encounter positions and discards:
· “Previous encounter” means the encounter immediately before the current one in the direction of play. “Past encounters” means every encounter before the current one. “Following encounter” means the encounter immediately after the current one in the direction of play.
· Discarded cards go face up into the discard pile, and any tokens on them return to the supply. Both players may inspect both discard piles at any time.
· If both cards in an encounter are discarded, later encounters shift forward to close the gap, and all position references are recalculated from the new order.

End of the game:
· Phase 1: if your opponent cannot play a card, you immediately win the game.
· Phase 2: if an ability you activate says you win the game, you immediately win.
· Phase 3: at the end of the round, a player with 5 or more signets wins. If both players have at least 5 signets and the same number, continue playing until one player has more signets or wins another way.
· If both players cannot play in phase 1, the player with more signets wins; if both have the same number, the game is a draw.

Deck I card abilities:
· Hired Blade (influence 1, Rebellion, instant ability): Discard this card and the opposing card, then close the encounter position left empty.
· Void Mage (influence 2, Academy, instant ability): Choose any played card and remove either all influence modifiers or all ongoing tokens from it.
· Surgeon (influence 3, Guild, instant ability): The next card you play gets -5 influence.
· Mediator (influence 4, Dynasty, ongoing ability): This encounter is a tie.
· Saboteur (influence 5, Rebellion, instant ability): Your opponent discards the top 2 cards of their deck.
· Fortune Teller (influence 6, Academy, instant ability): In the next encounter, your opponent reveals their card before you play yours.
· Palace Guard (influence 7, Guild, instant ability): Choose a faction. Your opponent may discard 1 card of that faction from their hand; if they do not, this card gets +7 influence.
· Judge (influence 8, Dynasty, ongoing ability): You win all tied encounters, including future ones. When a tie becomes your win, the opposing card ability is not triggered.
· Ambusher (influence 9, Rebellion, instant ability): Choose a faction. Your opponent discards all cards of that faction from their hand.
· Puppeteer (influence 10, Academy, instant ability): Discard the opposing card, then replace it with a random card from your opponent hand. The drawn card does not trigger its ability.
· Clockmaker (influence 11, Guild, instant ability): Your card in the previous encounter and the next card you play each get +3 influence.
· Treasurer (influence 12, Dynasty, ongoing ability): The card that wins the previous encounter is worth 1 additional signet.
· Swamp Guardian (influence 13, Rebellion, instant ability): Take one of your other played cards back into your hand and discard the card opposing it.
· Magistra (influence 14, Academy, instant ability): Copy and activate the instant ability of one of your other played cards whose influence is at least as high as this card influence.
· Inventor (influence 15, Guild, instant ability): Give any one card +3 influence and any other card -3 influence.
· Djinn (influence 16, Dynasty, instant ability): You immediately win the game.

Deck II card abilities:
· Poisoner (influence 1, Rebellion, instant ability): Reduce the influence of the opposing card until this encounter is a tie.
· Kinesis Mage (influence 2, Academy, instant ability): Move all influence modifiers and ongoing tokens from one of your cards to another of your played cards.
· Envoy (influence 3, Guild, instant ability): Give any one card -3 influence, or give the next card you play -3 influence.
· Tax Collector (influence 4, Dynasty, instant ability): This card gets +4 influence.
· Revolutionary (influence 5, Rebellion, instant ability): Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand, then draws 2 cards.
· Librarian (influence 6, Academy, instant ability): After the next card you play is revealed, choose whether it gets +2 or -2 influence.
· Prodigy (influence 7, Guild, instant ability): One of your played cards with 8 or less influence gets +3 influence.
· Aristocrat (influence 8, Dynasty, ongoing ability): If this card wins its encounter, it is worth 1 additional signet.
· Blackmailer (influence 9, Rebellion, instant ability): Choose a faction. If your opponent next played card is not of that faction, they discard 2 cards from their hand after revealing it.
· Illusionist (influence 10, Academy, instant ability): Activate the ability of one of your cards that is losing its encounter.
· Engineer (influence 11, Guild, instant ability): After abilities are resolved, the next card you play gets +5 influence.
· Counselor (influence 12, Dynasty, ongoing ability): In the previous encounter, your card wins and the opposing card loses.
· Witch King (influence 13, Rebellion, instant ability): Choose a faction. Your opponent discards all cards of that faction from their hand and deck, then shuffles their deck.
· Elemental (influence 14, Academy, instant ability): Discard a card with an instant ability from your hand, copy and activate that ability, then draw 1 card.
· Mechanical Djinn (influence 15, Guild, ongoing ability): If you win the following encounter, you immediately win the game.
· Successor (influence 16, Dynasty, instant ability): Your opponent discards their entire deck and all but 2 cards from their hand.

Locations:
· Serpent Temple (difficulty 1): Whenever you win a past encounter, draw 1 card and your opponent discards 1 card from their hand.
· Bazaar (difficulty 1): At the end of each round, do not draw cards. Whenever you have 1 card or fewer in hand, immediately draw 4 cards.
· Founder's Day (difficulty 3): If you ever win 3 successive encounters, you immediately win the game.
· Grand Library (difficulty 2): At the beginning of the game, draw 2 cards instead of 5. At the end of each round, draw 2 cards instead of 1.
· Scrapyard (difficulty 2): At the end of each round, if your deck has at least 2 cards, draw 2 cards instead of 1, then place 1 card from your hand under your deck.
· Auction House (difficulty 2): Whenever you reveal a card with less influence than your card in the previous encounter, discard the top card of your deck.
· Haunted Catacombs (difficulty 3): If you reveal a card of the same faction as your card in the previous encounter, you immediately lose the game.
· Foggy Swamp (difficulty 2): After you place cards, do not reveal the current encounter. Instead, reveal and resolve the previous encounter.

zh.name: 冲向黄金城
zh.desc: 组建探险队穿越丛林与河流，抢先抵达黄金城
zh.rules:
目标：
率先让全部棋子抵达黄金城的玩家赢得本局。第一位把棋子走到黄金城的玩家触发最后一轮：本轮中排在其后的每名玩家各再进行一个回合，随后本局结束。
开局准备：
每名玩家拿取一块远征板、一副起始牌组与对应颜色的棋子。起始牌组由 4 张旅行者、3 张探险家与 1 张水手组成。把它洗匀后作为抽牌堆，再抽取 4 张作为手牌。
市场板放置 6 堆牌：侦察兵、开路者、多面手、摄影师、宝箱与发报机。其余 12 堆牌放在市场板上方。
每回合的流程：
1. 出牌：从手牌打出任意数量的牌，用来移动棋子，和／或购买一张新牌。
2. 弃牌：把你这一回合打出的牌正面朝上放入弃牌堆。用于支付营地的牌改为移出游戏，不进入弃牌堆。你还可以选择保留或弃掉尚未使用的手牌，并针对每张牌分别决定；弃掉的手牌放入弃牌堆。
3. 补牌：从抽牌堆补牌，直到手牌达到 4 张。若你已经持有 4 张或更多手牌，则不补牌。抽牌堆用尽时，先把弃牌堆洗匀作为新的抽牌堆，再继续抽取。
移动：
每张地貌牌都带有砍刀、船桨或金币符号，以及对应的力量值。选择一张牌打在自己面前，然后让一个棋子走到相邻的六角格。
目标格的颜色必须与牌的符号一致：绿色丛林使用砍刀，蓝色水域使用船桨，黄色村庄使用金币。牌的力量必须不低于目标格标示的力量。
进入目标格后，如果这张牌还有剩余力量，你可以继续走向相邻的六角格。每次进入新格都必须单独满足符号与力量要求，并且要先扣除这张牌已经用掉的力量。
你不能把多张牌的力量合并起来走进同一个地貌格。你随时可以停止移动，剩余力量随即作废。
有些牌同时带有多种符号，例如探险家印有砍刀 1 与船桨 1。每次使用这种牌时，你只能选择其中一种符号，不能把两种符号的力量相加。
地形与特殊格：
丛林显示若干把砍刀，水域显示若干支船桨，村庄显示若干枚金币。格上符号的数量就是该格的力量。
废墟显示若干张卡牌符号。进入废墟不需要匹配符号，但你必须交出与符号数量相同的任意手牌。这些牌在回合结束时进入弃牌堆。
营地同样要求交出与符号数量相同的任意手牌，但这些牌直接从游戏中移除。营地是精简牌组的主要途径。
任何被其他棋子占据的六角格都无法进入。黄金城可以容纳多名玩家。
封锁：
封锁横在隘口上，格面标有符号、力量与编号。第一个想要通过的玩家必须打出一张符号匹配且力量足够的牌。通过后，该玩家收走这枚封锁标记，此后所有玩家都可以自由通过该格。
封锁的编号用于终局平手判定。玩家收走的封锁越多，平手时越占优势；数量相同时比较各自最高的封锁编号。
购买：
每回合最多购买一张牌，无论你是否已经移动。
带金币符号的牌按牌面力量计值，其他牌每张计半枚金币。你可以打出任意数量的手牌来凑钱，合计达到价格时便可以买下这张牌，且不找零。
买到的牌放入弃牌堆，不能直接加入手牌。
某种牌堆的 3 张牌全部售出后，市场板上会留下一个空位。此时你可以购买市场板上方的任意牌堆：把那堆牌放到空位上，并取走其中一张。市场板存在空位时，你仍然可以购买板上剩余的牌堆。
行动牌与物品牌：
紫色行动牌可以在自己回合的任意时点打出，执行效果后继续原来的行动流程。
制图师让你抽两张牌。罗盘让你抽三张牌，然后把它移出游戏。科学家让你抽一张牌，然后你可以从手牌移出一张。旅行日志让你抽两张牌，然后你可以从手牌移出至多两张，最后把它自己移出游戏。发报机让你从市场板或市场板上方免费取走一张牌，放入弃牌堆，然后把它自己移出游戏。土著让你把一个棋子走到相邻格，无视该格的符号与力量要求，也可以用来拆除封锁。
带划掉卡牌符号的牌是物品牌，每局只能使用一次。使用它本身的符号或功能后，把它移出游戏。
如果你只把它当作半枚金币，或者用它支付废墟的费用，则把它放入弃牌堆，而不是移出游戏。用它支付营地的费用时，仍然要按营地的规则把它移出游戏。
终局：
当一名玩家的全部棋子抵达黄金城时，本局进入最后一轮。本轮中排在其后的每名玩家各再进行一个回合，随后本局结束。如果最后一轮的最后一名玩家率先抵达，本局立即结束。
如果只有一名玩家抵达黄金城，该玩家获胜。如果有多名玩家抵达，收走封锁最多者获胜；封锁数量相同则比较各自最高的封锁编号；仍然相同则由最先抵达者获胜。
二人规则：
每名玩家控制两个棋子，分别从一号与三号、二号与四号起点出发。每当你打出一张移动牌时，先选择要把这张牌用于哪一个棋子。你不能把一张牌的力量拆分给两个棋子。
只有两个棋子都抵达黄金城，该玩家才算完成旅程。如果双方都在最后一轮用第二个棋子抵达，按通常的平手规则决定胜负。

en.name: The Quest for El Dorado
en.desc: Build an expedition, cross jungle and river, and reach El Dorado first
en.rules:
Goal:
Win the expedition by bringing all of your pieces to El Dorado first. The first player to reach it triggers the final round; each player after them in that round takes one more turn, and then the game ends.
Setup:
Each player takes an expedition board, a starting deck and a set of pieces. The starting deck contains 4 Travelers, 3 Explorers and 1 Sailor. Shuffle it as your draw pile, then draw 4 cards as your hand.
Place 6 card piles on the market board: Scout, Trailblazer, Jack-of-All-Trades, Photographer, Treasure Chest and Transmitter. Place the other 12 piles above the market board.
Each turn:
1. Play cards: play any number of cards from your hand to move your pieces and/or to buy one new card.
2. Discard: put the cards you played this turn face up on your discard pile. Cards paid for a base camp are removed from the game instead. You may also keep or discard each unused card in your hand; discard any you do not want, one card at a time.
3. Draw: draw cards until you have 4 cards in hand. If you already hold 4 or more cards, draw nothing. If your draw pile runs out, shuffle your discard pile to form a new draw pile, then continue drawing.
Movement:
Each terrain card shows a machete, paddle or coin symbol together with its power value. Play one card in front of you, then move one piece onto an adjacent hex.
The color of the destination must match the symbol on the card: green jungle uses machetes, blue water uses paddles, and yellow villages use coins. The card’s power must be at least the power shown on the destination.
After entering a space, you may use any remaining power to continue to an adjacent hex. Each new space must meet its own symbol and power requirement, after subtracting the power already spent from the same card.
You cannot combine the power of several cards to enter one terrain space. You may stop moving at any time; any unused power is lost immediately.
Some cards show more than one symbol, such as the Explorer with machete 1 and paddle 1. Each time you use such a card, choose exactly one of its symbols; you cannot add the symbols together.
Terrain and special spaces:
Jungle shows machetes, water shows paddles, and villages show coins. The number of symbols equals the power of the space.
Rubble shows card symbols. Entering rubble does not require a matching symbol, but you must pay one card from your hand for each symbol on the space. Those cards go to your discard pile at the end of the turn.
A base camp also requires one card per symbol, but those cards are removed from the game. Base camps are the main way to keep your deck lean.
You can never enter a space occupied by another piece. El Dorado can hold several players at once.
Blockades:
A blockade lies across a pass and shows a symbol, a power and a number. The first player who wants to pass must play a card whose symbol matches and whose power is sufficient. That player keeps the blockade, and from then on everyone may pass freely.
Blockade numbers break ties at the end of the game. The player with more blockades wins a tie; if the count is equal, compare the highest numbered blockade.
Buying:
You may buy at most one card per turn, whether or not you have moved.
Cards with a coin symbol are worth their power; every other card is worth half a coin. You may play any number of cards from your hand to pay the price. If the total reaches the price, you buy the card; no change is given.
The purchased card goes face up on your discard pile, not directly into your hand.
Once all 3 cards of a pile have been sold, the market board has a vacant spot. You may then buy from any pile above the market board: place that pile on the vacant spot and take one card from it. While a vacancy exists, you may still buy from the piles remaining on the board.
Action and item cards:
Purple action cards may be played at any time during your own turn; resolve the effect, then continue your turn.
The Cartographer draws 2 cards. The Compass draws 3 cards, then is removed from the game. The Scientist draws 1 card; you may then remove one card from your hand. The Travel Log draws 2 cards; you may then remove up to 2 cards from your hand, and the Travel Log itself is removed from the game. The Transmitter lets you take any one card from the market board or from above it for free and put it on your discard pile, then the Transmitter is removed from the game. The Native moves one of your pieces onto an adjacent space, ignoring that space’s requirements; it can also tear down a blockade.
Cards marked with a crossed-out card are item cards and may be used only once per game. When you use an item card for its own symbol or effect, remove it from the game.
If you use an item card only as half a coin, or to pay for rubble, put it on your discard pile instead of removing it. An item card spent to enter a base camp is still removed from the game.
End of the game:
When one player’s pieces have all reached El Dorado, the final round begins. The players after them in that round each take one more turn, and then the game ends. If the last player of the round reaches El Dorado first, the game ends immediately.
If only one player has reached El Dorado, that player wins. If several players have reached it, the player with the most blockades wins. If the blockade count is tied, the tied player with the highest numbered blockade wins. If they still tie, the player who arrived first wins.
Two-player rules:
Each player controls two pieces, starting on spaces #1 and #3 or on spaces #2 and #4. Whenever you play a movement card, first choose which of your pieces it applies to. You cannot split one card’s power between your two pieces.
A player completes the journey only when both pieces have reached El Dorado. If both players bring their second piece to El Dorado during the final round, use the usual tie-breaker rules.

zh.name: 工厂乐翻天
zh.desc: 选装机器、连接管线，把原料加工成成品；八轮后按总分排名，支持单人模式
zh.rules:
目标:
每位玩家经营一座工厂。你在八轮里各选取并安装一台机器，把它接入工厂网络，让原料从供应罐流入机器、加工后再送入下一台机器或输出罐。机器本身带来收入，妥善串联机器还能在终局额外得分；多人游戏中，八轮结束后钱最多者获胜。单人规则见下文。
准备:
· 每位玩家拿一块工厂板。工厂板共 37 个六边形格，中央一格为障碍、不能放置任何物件，其余 36 格为可放置的空格。
· 多人游戏时，把全部 48 台机器洗匀，面朝下组成牌堆，从牌堆翻开三台作为公共待选区；被取走一台后，立即从牌堆补一台。
· 每位玩家的现金从 10 元开始。多人游戏时随机决定起始玩家，之后按座位顺序轮流行动。
机器板:
· 每台机器是一块六边形板块。边缘的圆角端口是输入端，白点数量表示所需的原料单位数。带尖角的端口是输出端，数字表示产量，黑底白菱形表示产出 1 单位黑色成品。
· 牌心的浅色轮廓用来辨识机型。黑底数字是安装这台机器时立即获得的收入。
· 有些机器的端口可以用多种颜色，板块上以分色标出可选的颜色。安装时先选定一种颜色。机器安装之后，在轮到自己行动时可以点选这台机器更改这些端口的颜色；改色不消耗行动，但改完之后整座工厂仍然必须保持合法。
回合:
多人游戏时，每回合由当前玩家从待选区选择一台机器，安装到自己的工厂板上，随即从牌堆补一台到待选区。如果无法把选中的机器合法安装，可以取走这台机器而不安装，不会受到惩罚。当牌堆用尽时，把玩家没有安装的机器重新洗匀，组成新的牌堆。每位玩家各进行八个回合，八轮之后游戏结束。
单人模式:
· 单人游戏时，从全部机器中随机抽出八台，面朝下组成牌堆；每个回合翻开牌堆顶的一台机器，尝试把它安装进工厂。若无法安装或不愿安装，可以放弃这台机器，不会受到惩罚。
· 牌堆抽完即结束，共进行八个回合；结束后按与多人游戏相同的方式结算现金与清晰圆片。
安装与花费:
· 机器可以任意旋转，共有六个朝向。安装机器本身免费，并会立即获得黑底数字所示的收入。
· 每放置一个储罐或一根管道需要支付 1 元。
· 机器与储罐只能放在空格上，管道同样占用一个空格。
· 之前回合安装的机器不能再移动或取回；之前回合放置的储罐与管道可以免费取回。
连接规则:
· 机器的每个输入端与输出端都必须接入工厂网络。
· 输入端要么连接同色的供应储罐，要么由其他机器的同色输出供给。
· 输出端要么把产物送入其他机器的同色输入端，要么收入同色的输出储罐。
· 相连的端口颜色必须相同，不能混色。
· 汇集到一台机器的输入总量不能超过向它供料的输出总量；同一份输出可以拆分供给多台机器。
· 一台机器的输出不能经由任何路径接回它自己的输入。
· 不允许死端：任何储罐与管道都必须接入某台机器的端口，所有输出储罐都必须有产物送入。
储罐与管道:
· 供应储罐分为粉、黄、绿、蓝四色，每种颜色每位玩家最多放置一个。供应储罐无限产出，可同时供应多台机器，不会消耗。
· 输出储罐用于收集机器产物。白色输出储罐每位玩家最多放置三个，每个只能收集一种颜色；黑色输出储罐数量不限，只能收集黑色成品。
· 管道占用一个空格并携带一种颜色，用来把同色端口串联延长；四种颜色不能混用。
清晰圆片:
· 当一台机器的输入由其他机器供料、而不是由供应储罐供料时，在它的每个被机器供料的输入点上放一枚清晰圆片。
· 如果之后改用供应储罐供料，就移除对应的清晰圆片。
· 每枚清晰圆片按其覆盖的点数，在终局计分时每点计 3 元。
计分:
· 八轮全部结束后结算：所有现金加上清晰圆片的计分，总分最高者获胜，并列则共享胜利。

en.name: Factory Funner
en.desc: Draft machines, wire your pipes, and process products — highest total after eight rounds wins; solo mode supported
en.rules:
Goal:
Each player runs a factory. Over eight rounds you each draft one machine per round and install it into your factory network, so that product flows from supply reservoirs through machines and on to other machines or output reservoirs. Machines earn revenue when installed, and chaining them earns extra points at the end. In a multiplayer game, the player with the most money after eight rounds wins; solo rules are described below.
Setup:
· Each player takes one factory board. A board has 37 hexagonal spaces in all; the center space is an obstacle and nothing may be placed on it, leaving 36 playable spaces.
· In a multiplayer game, shuffle all 48 machines face down into a deck, then turn three face up into a shared display. Whenever a machine is taken, immediately refill the display from the deck.
· Each player starts with $10. In a multiplayer game, the first player is chosen at random, and play proceeds in seat order.
Machines:
· Each machine is a hexagonal tile. A rounded port is an input, and its white dots show how many units of material it needs. A pointed port is an output. Its number shows how many units it produces, and a white diamond on a black port means one unit of black end product.
· The pale silhouette identifies the machine. The number on the black plate is the revenue you gain when you install it.
· Some machine ports accept more than one color, shown on the tile as several color bands. Choose one color when you install the machine. On your later turns you may tap an installed machine to change these port colors; changing colors does not use your action, but the whole factory must remain legal afterwards.
Turn:
In a multiplayer game, on your turn, choose one machine from the display and install it on your factory board, then refill the display from the deck. If you cannot legally install the machine you chose, you may take it without installing it, with no penalty. When the deck runs out, shuffle the machines that players did not install to form a new deck. Every player takes eight turns, after which the game ends.
Solo mode:
· In a solo game, randomly take eight machines from the full set and form them into a face-down deck. Each turn, turn over the top machine of the deck and try to install it in your factory. If you cannot or do not wish to install it, you may give up that machine with no penalty.
· The game lasts eight turns, until the deck is empty. At the end, score cash and clear chips exactly as in the multiplayer game.
Installing and costs:
· Machines may be rotated freely into any of six orientations. Placing a machine is free, and you immediately gain the revenue on its black plate.
· Each reservoir or pipe you place costs $1.
· Machines and reservoirs may only be placed on empty spaces; pipes also occupy one space.
· Machines installed on earlier turns can never be moved or taken back; reservoirs and pipes placed on earlier turns can be taken back for free.
Connecting:
· Every input and output of a machine must connect into the factory network.
· An input either connects to a supply reservoir of the same color, or is fed by a same-color output from another machine.
· An output either feeds a same-color input of another machine, or is collected by a same-color output reservoir.
· Connected ports must share the same color; colors cannot be mixed.
· The total input gathered by a machine cannot exceed the total output feeding it; one output may be split to feed several machines.
· A machine's output may never, by any path, connect back to its own input.
· No dead ends are allowed: every reservoir and pipe must connect to a machine port, and every output reservoir must receive product.
Reservoirs and pipes:
· Supply reservoirs come in pink, yellow, green, and blue. Each player may place at most one of each color. A supply reservoir produces without limit, can feed several machines at once, and is never consumed.
· Output reservoirs collect machine product. Each player may place at most three white output reservoirs, and each collects a single color; black output reservoirs are unlimited and collect only black end product.
· A pipe occupies one space and carries one color, extending a same-color connection; the four colors cannot be mixed in one pipe.
Clear chips:
· When a machine's input is fed by another machine rather than by a supply reservoir, place a clear chip on each input dot fed by a machine.
· If that input later switches to a supply reservoir, remove the clear chip.
· At the end, each clear chip scores $3 for every dot it covers.
Scoring:
· After all eight rounds, add every player's cash to the value of their clear chips. The highest total wins; ties share the win.

zh.name: Fadenfroh
zh.desc: 争抢布料与针线，把花纹缝进三行绣布，五轮后得分最高者获胜
zh.rules:
目标:
· 五轮结束时总分最高的玩家获胜；总分相同时，起始卡组号更大的玩家获胜。
准备:
· 每名玩家取得同一组的 3 张起始卡，分别放在面前三行的最左端。
· 每名玩家取得 1 个线轴和 1 根针。
· 从四个类别各抽 1 张计分卡，洗匀后分别放在轮次板的四角，依次称为 A、B、C、D。
· 持有顶针的玩家成为第 1 轮的起始玩家。
每轮流程:
· 每轮依次经过市场、采购、刺绣和计分四个阶段，共进行五轮。
市场:
· 顶针持有者把顶针放入市场，并成为本轮的起始玩家。
· 按照玩家人数摆出材料与报价；2 人使用 4 个线轴、1 根针和 2 组报价，3 人使用 7 个线轴、2 根针和 3 组报价，4 人使用 10 个线轴、2 根针和 4 组报价。
· 布料堆用完时，把弃牌堆洗匀后作为新的布料堆。
采购:
· 从起始玩家开始按顺时针轮流行动，直到所有玩家都停手。
· 轮到行动时，可以从市场取走 1 个线轴、1 根针或顶针，也可以停手并取走 1 组报价的全部卡牌。
· 市场里没有某种材料时，不能选择该材料。
· 停手取走报价后，本轮的采购对这名玩家结束。
· 其他玩家都已停手时，你取走市场剩余的全部材料，然后必须停手并取走 1 组报价。
刺绣:
· 全部玩家停手后，进入刺绣阶段。
· 拥有至少 3 个线轴时，必须立即向总供应归还 3 个线轴，从布料堆抽 3 张牌，留下 1 张放入自己的供应区，其余 2 张明置弃牌堆。
· 兑换后仍有至少 3 个线轴时，重复兑换，直到少于 3 个线轴。
· 面前有三行，每行以 1 张起始卡开始。
· 放置的新卡至少覆盖另一张已放牌的 1 个半张；一张卡可以同时覆盖相邻的 2 个半张。
· 把牌紧贴另一张卡平放而不覆盖时，必须在这两张卡之间放置 1 根针。
· 卡牌不能旋转，不能塞到其他卡牌之下，已经放好的卡牌也不能再移动。
· 针不参与同色或同符号的分组，也不影响相邻关系的判定。
· 不准备摆放的卡牌必须明置弃牌堆，不能保留到下一轮。
· 全部玩家完成刺绣后，进入计分阶段。
· 每轮结束时可以保留全部针和至多 2 个线轴，顶针交还给市场。
计分:
· 第 1 轮不计分。
· 第 2 轮计算 A 和 B，第 3 轮计算 B 和 C，第 4 轮计算 C 和 D，第 5 轮计算 A 和 D。
· 每次计分时，绣布上每个羽毛圈另计 2 分。
· 第 5 轮计分时，每名玩家从 B 和 C 中选择一张计分卡计分。
· 第 5 轮计分时，供应区里每个材料另计 2 分。
· 第 5 轮计分时，绣布上的每个绣绷按其对应符号的数量计分，每个对应符号计 3 分。
· 只有绣布上可见的半张和符号参与计分，绣绷上的符号不计分。
· 计分卡的具体条件以当轮展示的卡面说明为准。
相邻与分组:
· 两个半张或两个符号共享一条边时视为相邻，只包含上下左右四个方向。
· 一组由所有相邻且颜色相同或符号相同的半张组成。
单人规则:
· 每次取走材料后，翻出布料堆顶牌并明置弃牌堆。
· 翻出的牌带有羽毛圈或绣绷时，按针、顶针、线轴的顺序从市场归还 1 个材料到总供应。
· 翻出的牌两个半张颜色相同时，把市场最左边的牌弃置；颜色不同时，把市场最右边的牌弃置。
· 本轮不是起始玩家时，首次行动前先翻 1 张牌。
· 停手时最多取走 2 张相邻的市场牌，其余市场牌弃置，剩余材料归还总供应。
结束:
· 五轮的计分阶段全部结束后，总分最高的玩家获胜。

en.name: Fadenfroh
en.desc: Race for fabric and materials, stitch patterns into three rows, and score the most after five rounds
en.rules:
Goal:
· The player with the highest total after five rounds wins; on a tie, the player with the higher starting-card set number wins.
Setup:
· Each player takes the 3 starting cards of one set and places them at the left end of the three rows in front of them.
· Each player takes 1 thread and 1 needle.
· Draw 1 scoring card from each of the four categories, shuffle them, and place one in each corner of the round overview board as A, B, C, and D.
· The player holding the thimble becomes the starting player of round 1.
Round flow:
· Each round passes through the market, shopping, embroidery, and scoring phases; the game lasts exactly five rounds.
Market:
· The thimble holder places the thimble in the market and becomes the starting player of the round.
· Lay out materials and offers according to the player count; 2 players use 4 threads, 1 needle, and 2 offers, 3 players use 7 threads, 2 needles, and 3 offers, and 4 players use 10 threads, 2 needles, and 4 offers.
· If the fabric pile runs out, shuffle the discard pile into a new fabric pile.
Shopping:
· Play proceeds clockwise from the starting player until every player has passed.
· On your turn, take 1 thread, 1 needle, or the thimble from the market, or pass and take all cards of 1 offer.
· If a material is not available in the market, you cannot choose it.
· After you pass and take an offer, your shopping phase for the round is over.
· If everyone else has already passed, you take all remaining material from the market and must then pass and take an offer.
Embroidery:
· After every player has passed, the embroidery phase begins.
· If you have at least 3 threads, you must immediately return 3 threads to the general supply, draw 3 cards, keep 1 in your supply, and place the other 2 face up on the discard pile.
· If you still have at least 3 threads after the exchange, repeat the exchange until you have fewer than 3 threads.
· Your display has three rows, each starting with 1 starting card.
· A new card must cover at least 1 half of another placed card; one card may cover 2 adjacent halves at once.
· To place a card next to another card without covering it, place 1 needle between those two cards.
· Cards cannot be rotated, cannot be slid beneath other cards, and placed cards cannot be moved.
· Needles do not affect color or symbol groups and do not change adjacency.
· Any card you do not place must go face up on the discard pile and cannot be kept for later rounds.
· After every player finishes embroidery, the scoring phase begins.
· At the end of a round you may keep all needles and up to 2 threads, and the thimble returns to the market.
Scoring:
· There is no scoring in round 1.
· Round 2 scores A and B, round 3 scores B and C, round 4 scores C and D, and round 5 scores A and D.
· Every scoring phase also gives 2 VP for each feather circle in your display.
· In round 5, each player chooses scoring card B or C to score.
· In round 5, each material in your supply scores 2 VP.
· In round 5, each embroidery hoop scores 3 VP for each matching symbol in your display.
· Only halves and symbols visible in your display count; symbols on embroidery hoops do not count.
· The exact condition of each scoring card is shown on the card during the round.
Adjacency and groups:
· Two halves or symbols are adjacent when they share an edge, so only up, down, left, and right count.
· A group consists of all adjacent halves with the same color or symbols with the same type.
Solo rules:
· After each time you take material, reveal the top card of the fabric pile and place it face up on the discard pile.
· If the revealed card shows a feather circle or an embroidery hoop, return 1 material from the market to the general supply in the order needle, thimble, thread.
· If the revealed card has the same color on both halves, discard the leftmost market card; if the colors differ, discard the rightmost market card.
· If you are not the starting player of the round, reveal 1 card before your first turn.
· When you pass, take up to 2 adjacent market cards, discard all remaining market cards, and return all remaining material to the general supply.
End:
· After the scoring phase of round 5, the player with the highest total wins.

zh.name: 盖亚计划
zh.desc: 改造行星、扩张联邦、攀爬六条研究轨的星际殖民对决
zh.rules:
本游戏支持 2–4 人。通过改造行星、扩建建筑、发展研究和建立联邦获得胜利点，六轮后得分最高的玩家获胜。
开局:
· 系统为每位玩家分配一个派系，并在该派系的母星上布置起始建筑。伊维特人从一座行星研究所开始，泽诺斯人从三座矿场开始，其余派系从两座矿场开始。
· 玩家从末位起逆序选择强化板，随后结算第一轮收入。
每轮流程:
· 收入阶段按派系、建筑、研究、强化板和科技板结算收入。盖亚阶段将能量按派系规则从盖亚区移回能量循环，并完成上一轮开始的盖亚改造。
· 行动阶段轮流行动。玩家通过后停止本轮行动，并在前五轮领取下一轮的强化板。最先通过的玩家成为下一轮先手。所有玩家通过后进入下一轮，第六轮结束后结算。
行动:
· 建造矿场时，选择一个可达的行星，支付建筑所需的信用点和矿石。用矿石支付地形改造费用，需要延伸航程时可支付 QIC。
· 开始盖亚改造时，将一个可用的盖亚改造器放到可达的虚境行星上，并按研究板所示数量将能量标记移入盖亚区。
· 矿场可以升级为贸易站，贸易站可以升级为行星研究所或实验室，实验室可以升级为学院。建成实验室或学院时获得科技板。取得高级科技板时，翻面一枚绿色联邦标记，并覆盖一张标准科技板。你随后可以选择推进一条符合条件的研究轨。
· 支付 4 点知识可以推进一级研究。进入第 5 级需要翻面一枚绿色联邦标记，每条轨道只能有一位玩家到达第 5 级。每当推进到航行第 5 级时，在星图上选择一个可达的空格放置失落行星。
· 组建联邦时，用建筑和卫星连成达到所需战力的整体，并领取一枚联邦标记。每颗卫星放在空格内，通常需要弃置一枚能量标记。新联邦不能与自己的其他联邦相邻。
· 每个公共行动格每轮全桌只能使用一次。扩展对局的 QIC 行动由舰船提供。支付所示费用后，领取行动格上的收益。自由行动可在自己的回合内执行，多次执行仍不结束回合。
被动充能:
· 你建造或升级建筑后，在两格内拥有建筑的对手可以依次选择充能。充能量受他们在范围内最高的建筑战力和可充能量限制。第 1 点免费，之后每充 1 点支付 1 个胜利点。
终局计分:
· 两项终局目标均按名次授予 18、12 和 6 分。两人局加入中立目标值参与比较。
· 每条研究轨从第 3 级起，每达到一级获得 4 分。剩余的信用点、知识和矿石每合计 3 点获得 1 分。
扩展模式:
· 建立房间时可以选择启用《The Lost Fleet》扩展。启用后，派系池加入 Space Giants、Moweyds、Darkanians 与 Tinkeroids，并在星图外围布置深空星区与交界区。
· 两人局使用三艘舰船。三至四人局使用四艘舰船。把探索穿梭机停靠到舰船上时，需要从你的殖民点计算航程并支付费用，通常为 5 点胜利点；停靠后按该机位充能，同时获得这艘舰船提供的行动。
· 每艘舰船都有三种行动，分别以 QIC、能量、知识或信用点支付，可以换取资源、推进研究、免费建矿、免费升级建筑或重复结算联邦标记等收益。Twilight 舰船上还停放着神器，弃置六枚能量标记后，可以从中选择一件并立即结算。
· 组建联邦时，如果你的穿梭机停靠的舰船上还有金色联邦标记，你可以改取这枚金色标记。金色标记提供 12 点胜利点、一次自选科技、一次无限射程建矿或一次带 3 步免费改造的建矿。
· 新行星规则：在小行星上建造矿场需要消耗一个盖亚改造器；在原行星上建造矿场需要 3 步地形改造。
· Tinkeroids 每轮开始时选一张未用过的拼装片。第 1–3 轮使用第一组，第 4–6 轮使用第二组。本轮结束时移除选中的拼装片。
· 扩展还提供新的标准科技、高级科技、强化板以及回合计分与终局计分板块，启用后一并加入对局。

en.name: Gaia Project
en.desc: Terraform planets, build federations and climb six research tracks in a contest for the galaxy
en.rules:
This game supports 2–4 players. Earn victory points by settling planets, upgrading buildings, advancing research and forming federations. The player with the most points after six rounds wins.
Setup:
· The game deals each player a faction and places its starting buildings on home planets. Ivits begin with one planetary institute. Xenos begin with three mines. Other factions begin with two mines.
· Draft boosters in reverse seat order, then collect the first round’s income.
Round structure:
· During income, collect the benefits provided by your faction, buildings, research, booster and technology tiles. During the Gaia phase, return tokens from the Gaia area to your power cycle as specified by your faction and finish Gaia projects started in the previous round.
· Take turns during the action phase. When you pass, stop taking actions for the round and, in rounds one through five, claim a booster for the next round. The first player to pass goes first next round. After everyone passes, begin the next round or score the game if round six has ended.
Actions:
· To build a mine, select a reachable planet and pay the construction cost in credits and ore. Pay ore for any terraforming steps and spend QIC if you need to extend your range.
· To start a Gaia project, place an available Gaiaformer on a reachable Transdim planet and move the required number of power tokens to the Gaia area.
· Upgrade a mine to a trading station, a trading station to a planetary institute or research lab, or a research lab to an academy. Building a research lab or an academy grants a technology tile. When you take an advanced tile, flip a green federation token and cover one of your standard tiles. You may then advance on an eligible research track of your choice.
· Spend 4 knowledge to advance one level on a research track. To reach level 5, flip a green federation token. Only one player can occupy level 5 of each track. Whenever you reach Navigation level 5, choose a reachable empty hex for the Lost Planet.
· To form a federation, connect buildings and satellites that meet the required power and take a federation token. Each satellite occupies an empty hex and usually costs one discarded power token. A new federation cannot border another of your federations.
· Each shared action space can be used once per round. In expansion games, QIC actions are available on spaceships. Pay the cost shown to receive its benefit. You can take multiple free actions on your turn without ending it.
Passive charging:
· When you build or upgrade, opponents with a building within two hexes may choose to charge. The offer is limited by their highest building power in range and by how much they can charge. The first charge is free. Each additional charge costs 1 victory point.
Final scoring:
· Each final objective awards 18, 12 and 6 points by rank. In a two-player game, a neutral benchmark also competes for these awards.
· Earn 4 points for each research level reached from level 3 onward. Earn 1 point for every 3 leftover credits, knowledge and ore combined.
Expansion Mode:
· You can enable The Lost Fleet expansion when creating a room. When enabled, the faction pool adds Space Giants, Moweyds, Darkanians and Tinkeroids, and the board gains deep space sectors and interspace tiles around the outer edge.
· Use three spaceships in a two-player game and four spaceships in a three- or four-player game. To dock an exploration shuttle on a spaceship, measure the range from one of your colonies and pay the cost, usually 5 victory points. Docking charges power for that slot and unlocks the actions printed on that spaceship.
· Each spaceship offers three actions paid with QIC, power, knowledge or credits, granting resources, research advancement, free mines, free upgrades or a repeat of a federation token. The Twilight spaceship also holds artifacts. Discard six power tokens to choose and resolve one of them.
· When you form a federation and one of your shuttles is on a spaceship that still holds a gold-outlined federation token, you may take that gold token instead. It grants 12 victory points, a tech of your choice, a limitless-range mine, or a mine with up to 3 free terraforming steps.
· New planet rules: building a mine on an asteroid consumes a Gaiaformer, and building a mine on a protoplanet requires 3 terraforming steps.
· Tinkeroids choose an unused Tinkering tile at the start of each round. Use the first set in rounds 1–3 and the second set in rounds 4–6. Remove the chosen tile at the end of the round.
· The expansion also adds new standard and advanced techs, boosters, and round and final scoring tiles, which join the game when enabled.

zh.name: 奥地利大饭店
zh.desc: 在维也纳的黄金年代经营酒店，安排宾客、准备客房并取悦皇帝
zh.rules:
目标：经过七轮经营，把咖啡馆中的宾客安置进客房并满足他们的餐饮订单，同时取悦皇帝。终局时胜利点数最高的玩家获胜。
开局准备：每名玩家拥有 10 克朗、一块酒店版图、一块金钱轨、一块皇帝轨与三枚目标标记。底层左侧的三间客房在开局时已经免费准备好；厨房中各有 1 份果卷、1 份蛋糕、1 份红葡萄酒与 1 份咖啡；手中抽取 6 张员工卡，咖啡馆中安置 1 位宾客。
公共区域按 A、B、C 三组各随机翻开 1 张目标卡与 1 张皇帝板块。宾客牌堆洗匀后，在版图下方组成 5 位宾客的队列。
每轮流程：起始玩家掷出全部骰子（2 人 10 枚、3 人 12 枚、4 人 14 枚），按点数放到行动板上对应的行动格。每名玩家在每轮各有两次行动机会，按自己回合顺序板上当前可见的最小数字依次行动。
你的回合开始时，可以先从队列中迎接 1 位宾客，也可以跳过。迎接宾客须支付队列位置标示的费用（依次为 3、2、1、0、0 克朗），随后把宾客放到咖啡馆的空桌位；咖啡馆最多容纳 3 位宾客。
随后你必须选择一个至少还有 1 枚骰子的行动格，取走 1 枚骰子，并以该行动格的骰子数量作为行动强度。你可以支付 1 克朗把强度提高 1，每回合最多一次。取走的骰子用于遮住你回合顺序板上当前最小的数字。
跳过：你也可以在轮到你时不行动而选择跳过。跳过不会放弃回合，只会把行动推迟到重新掷骰之后。当其他所有玩家也都跳过或已完成两次行动时，从行动板上取走剩余骰子，把其中一枚放到垃圾桶，其余骰子重新掷出并按点数放回行动格，然后由回合顺序数字最小的玩家继续决定行动或跳过。若玩家继续跳过，就重复这一过程，直到所有玩家都完成两次行动，或没有骰子可以重掷为止。
取餐点：获得等于强度的果卷与蛋糕，其中果卷数量不得少于蛋糕。
饮品台：获得等于强度的红葡萄酒与咖啡，其中红葡萄酒数量不得少于咖啡。
客房准备：最多准备等于强度的客房。新客房必须与已有客房上下左右相邻，颜色须与版图格一致，并按楼层支付费用（一层免费，二层 1 克朗，三层 2 克朗，四层 3 克朗）。右上角带胜利点数的客房在放置时立即得分。
皇帝与金币：把等于强度的点数自由分配给皇帝轨和金钱轨。皇帝轨走到 13 格后，每多走 1 格改为获得 1 点胜利点数；金钱最多保留 20 克朗。
聘请员工：从手中打出 1 张员工卡，费用按行动强度减免，最低为 0。员工卡打出后留在展示区，其效果立即结算。
模仿行动：支付 1 克朗，选择其余五种主要行动之一，以模仿行动格上的骰子数量作为强度执行。被模仿的行动格不需要仍有骰子。
获得食材与饮品时，系统会自动把它们放到咖啡馆中能够匹配的宾客订单上，无法放置的部分进入厨房。你也可以在回合中的任意时点从厨房取用。
附加行动：在你的回合中，除主要行动外还可以任意次执行以下附加行动。
· 上菜：支付 1 克朗，从厨房把至多 3 份食材或饮品移到一位或多位宾客的订单上。
· 完成目标：若满足某张目标卡的条件，把一枚标记放到该卡剩余的最高分位置并立即得分。每张目标卡每人只能领取一次。
· 使用员工：展示区中带每轮可用标记的员工卡每轮可使用一次，使用后横置。
· 送客入住：当一位宾客的订单全部满足后，可以把他送入一间颜色相符的空置客房，并把该客房翻开为已入住。绿色宾客可以入住任意颜色。随后获得宾客卡上的胜利点数与奖励，订单上的食材归还供应堆。
入住奖励：当某一组同色客房全部入住时，立即获得该组的入住奖励：蓝色给胜利点数，红色给克朗，黄色给皇帝轨步数。每组只奖励一次。
皇帝结算：第 3、5、7 轮结束时进行皇帝结算。先按皇帝轨当前位置获得胜利点数（0 至 13 格依次为 0、1、1、3、4、4、5、5、6、6、7、7、8、9 分），再后退 3、5、7 格。后退后位于 3 格或以上时获得当轮皇帝板块上半部的奖励；位于 1 至 2 格时无事发生；位于 0 格时承受下半部的惩罚。皇帝轨不会因结算清零。
终局计分：第 7 轮皇帝结算后进行终局计分。先结算展示区中带终局标记的员工卡，再按已入住客房的楼层计分（一至四层每间分别为 1、2、3、4 分），然后厨房中每份剩余食材与金钱轨上每 1 克朗各获得 1 分，最后咖啡馆中每位尚未入住的宾客扣 5 分。
平手判定：胜利点数相同时，比较终局计分第三步所得分数（剩余食材与克朗），较高者获胜。
系统说明：皇帝板块的奖励与惩罚、皇帝奖励中要准备或翻为已入住的客房、以及获得食材与饮品的放置位置，均由系统自动处理。如果奖励要求你从抽到的员工卡中打出 1 张，则由你亲自选择打出的卡。终局时，秘书会自动复制对手展示区中收益最高的一项终局效果，另一位秘书的复制效果不计入；行李员会自动为胜利点数最高的未完成订单补满全部食材与饮品；宾客奖励或员工效果要求把空置客房翻为已入住时，系统也会自动选择客房。其余选择由你亲自决定。

en.name: Grand Austria Hotel
en.desc: Run a Viennese hotel in the golden age: seat guests, prepare rooms and win the Emperor’s favour
en.rules:
Goal: over seven rounds, move guests from your café into hotel rooms, fulfil their food and drink orders and earn the Emperor’s favour. The player with the most victory points wins.
Setup: each player starts with 10 krones, a hotel board, a money track, an Emperor track and three objective markers. The three rooms at the bottom left are already prepared for free. Your kitchen holds 1 strudel, 1 cake, 1 wine and 1 coffee. Draw 6 staff cards into your hand and seat 1 guest in your café.
For each letter A, B and C, reveal one random objective card and one random Emperor tile in the common area. Shuffle the guest deck and form a queue of 5 guests below the board.
Round flow: the start player rolls all dice (10 for 2 players, 12 for 3, 14 for 4) and places them on the matching action spaces. Each player takes two turns per round, acting in increasing order of the lowest visible number on their turn order tile.
At the start of your turn, you may take 1 guest from the queue or skip this step. Taking a guest costs the amount shown under its queue position (3, 2, 1, 0 and 0 krones) and places the guest at an empty table in your café, which holds at most 3 guests.
Then you must choose an action space with at least 1 die, take 1 die from it and use the number of dice on that space as the action strength. You may pay 1 krone to increase the strength by 1, at most once per turn. The die you take covers the lowest visible number on your turn order tile.
Passing: instead of taking a turn, you may pass. Passing does not forfeit your turn; it only postpones it until the dice are rerolled. Once every other player has also passed or taken both of their turns, take the remaining dice from the action board, remove one die and place it on the dustbin, reroll the rest and distribute them on the action spaces as before, then continue with the player showing the lowest number on their turn order tile. If players keep passing, repeat this until all players have taken both turns or no dice remain to reroll.
Taking Dishes: gain strudel and cake equal to the strength. You must take at least as much strudel as cake.
Taking Drinks: gain wine and coffee equal to the strength. You must take at least as much wine as coffee.
Preparing Rooms: prepare up to a number of rooms equal to the strength. Each new room must be orthogonally adjacent to an existing room, match the colour of its space and pay the floor cost (floor 1 free, floor 2 costs 1 krone, floor 3 costs 2, floor 4 costs 3). Rooms with a victory point symbol score immediately when placed.
Gaining Favour and Money: split the strength between the Emperor track and your money. Past space 13 on the Emperor track, each further step scores 1 victory point instead. Money is capped at 20 krones.
Playing a Staff Card: play 1 staff card from your hand, reducing its cost by the action strength to a minimum of 0. The card stays in your display and its effect resolves immediately.
Imitating a Main Action: pay 1 krone, choose one of the other five main actions and carry it out with the number of dice on the imitation space as its strength. The imitated space does not need any dice left.
When you gain dishes or drinks, the game automatically places them on matching guest orders in your café and puts whatever cannot be placed into your kitchen. You may also use items from your kitchen at any time during your turn.
Additional actions: during your turn you may take any number of the following additional actions in addition to your main action.
· Serving Items: pay 1 krone to move up to 3 dishes or drinks from your kitchen onto one or more guest orders.
· Completing an Objective: if you meet an objective card’s requirement, place a marker on its highest remaining scoring spot and score that many victory points immediately. Each player may claim each objective card only once.
· Using a Staff Card: a staff card in your display with the once-per-round symbol may be used once each round; turn it sideways after use.
· Moving a Guest to a Room: when a guest’s order is complete, move that guest into a vacant room of matching colour and turn the room to its occupied side. Green guests may enter any colour. Score the guest’s victory points and resolve its reward, then return the order items to the supply.
Occupancy bonus: when every room in a group of the same colour is occupied, gain that group’s bonus immediately: blue gives victory points, red gives krones and yellow advances the Emperor track. Each group pays its bonus only once.
Emperor scoring: at the end of rounds 3, 5 and 7, score victory points for your position on the Emperor track (spaces 0 to 13 are worth 0, 1, 1, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 7, 7, 8 and 9 points), then retreat 3, 5 and 7 spaces respectively. After retreating, a position of 3 or more gains the reward on the current Emperor tile; 1 or 2 does nothing; 0 suffers the penalty. The Emperor track is not reset by scoring.
Final scoring: after the Emperor scoring of round 7, score staff cards with the final-scoring symbol, then score occupied rooms by floor (1, 2, 3 and 4 victory points per room on floors 1 to 4), then 1 victory point for each item left in your kitchen and each krone left on your money track, and finally lose 5 victory points for each guest still in your café.
Tie-break: if victory points are equal, the player with the higher score from step 3 of final scoring (leftover items and krones) wins.
System note: the game handles Emperor tile rewards and penalties automatically, including which rooms an Emperor reward prepares or occupies and where the dishes and drinks you gain are placed. If a reward asks you to play one of the staff cards you drew, you choose which card to play. At final scoring, the Secretary automatically copies the highest-scoring end-game effect among your opponents’ staff cards, not counting another Secretary; the Porter automatically fills every dish and drink on the order of the unfinished guest worth the most victory points; and when a guest reward or staff effect turns vacant rooms into occupied rooms, the game also selects the rooms. All other choices are made by you.
